USKI CLASS KA OPENING HOOK

“Aadha jug paani hai. Ek-chauthai jug aur daalein, toh kitna bharega?”

Ghar par nimbu paani banaane ki chhoti kahaani se fractions shuru honge.

½
Aadha jug bhara hai
²⁄₄
Wahi aadha = 2 quarters
¾
1 quarter aur daala = 3 quarters

“Aadha jug ko 2 quarters socho. Ab 1 quarter aur. Total 3 quarters—yaani ¾ jug.”

PEHLA REINFORCEMENT“Aadha ko 2 quarters kyun likha?”

Usi idea ko Aanya apne words mein samjhayegi. Teesre example ke baad ek aur recap hoga.

Riddle ya short story kab aayegi?

Kahaani opening hook mein hai. Agar beech mein attention wapas laane ki zaroorat ho, toh ek chhoti riddle aa sakti hai: “Ek roti ke 4 barabar pieces. 2 kha liye—kitni roti khaayi?” Phir usi concept par class aage badhegi.

HIS CLASS OPENS WITH A CHALLENGE

“Half an hour batting. A quarter-hour fielding. Did you practise for a full hour?”

Kabir ki familiar cricket practice se sawaal shuru hoga. Explanation short hoga, phir woh isi idea ko apply karega.

Batting
15 minBatting
15 minFielding
15 minUnused

½ + ¼ = ¾ hour = 45 minutes

“Half an hour is two quarter-hours. Add one more: three quarters, or 45 minutes.”

APPLICATION KE BAAD REINFORCEMENT“Why did we keep quarters the same and add only the number of quarters?”

School ground ke chakkar wale doosre example ke baad Kabir rule apne words mein batayega.

Joke ya “good to know” kab aayega?

Examples ke beech halka joke ya curiosity jagaane wala “good to know” moment tab aayega, jab woh concept aur Kabir ke engagement ke liye useful ho. Har lecture mein ek hi joke ya ek fixed break zaroori nahi.

PERSONALISATION HAR TEACHING CHOICE MEIN

Language se lekar examples tak.
Har choice uske hisaab se.

ILP ki learning memory se bachche ki zaroorat samajh aayegi. Into3 usi ke hisaab se lecture ke alag-alag hisse chunega aur jodega.

01Language

English ya Hinglish? Jis language mein bachche ko samajhna aasaan lage.

02Tone

Calm, encouraging ya challenge dene wala? Samjhaane ka andaaz bhi uske hisaab se.

03Depth aur pace

Kitni detail mein samjhaana hai? Kahan ek-ek step chahiye, kahan aage badhna hai?

04Kitne examples?

Ek example kaafi hai ya aur chahiye? Unki ginti aur type bachche ki zaroorat se.

05Kitne reinforcements?

Concept kitni baar, kis point par dobara yaad karaana aur check karna hai?

06Kaunsa opening hook?

Sawaal, challenge, short story ya familiar situation—class ki shuruaat kis se ho?

07Engagement content kab?

Joke, short story, riddle ya “good to know”—sahi moment par, jab seekhne mein madad kare.

08Kis duniya ke examples?

Locality, surroundings aur familiarity: ghar, mohalla, school, dukaan aur pehle se jaani hui cheezein.

CLASS CHAL RAHI HAI. PERSONALISATION BHI.

Bachche ke jawaab, samajh aur engagement se in choices ko dobara adjust kiya ja sakega. RTAE apni understanding se changes suggest karega; ILP unhe coordinate karega. Chapter ke zaroori concepts cover honge.

PRE-BOOK KARNE SE PEHLE

Aapke sawaal.
Seedhe jawaab.

Into3 team se baat kijiye
Personal lecture mein kya badlega?

Language, tone, depth aur speed ke saath opening hook, examples ki ginti aur context, reinforcement ki ginti aur timing, aur joke, story, riddle ya “good to know” content kab aayega—yeh sab personal ho sakta hai. Examples bachche ki locality, surroundings aur un cheezon se judenge jo woh pehle se jaanta hai. Choices learning history aur current responses se badalengi.

Kya ek locality ke sab bachchon ko same examples milenge?

Nahi. Locality context ka ek hissa hai. Bachche ki routine, familiarity, pasand aur learning history bhi matter karti hai. Cricket sirf tab relevant example hai jab us bachche ko cricket ka context samajh aata ho.

Kya chapter ke important concepts chhoot jaayenge?

Personal lecture mein chapter ke zaroori concepts cover honge. Farq hoga explanation ke order, examples, detail aur pace mein. Jahan bachcha pehle se samajhta hai, wahan recap; jahan gap hai, wahan zyada madad.

Personalisation aur teaching style mein kya farq hai?

Style samjhaane ka andaaz hai—jaise sports ya Bollywood. Personalisation poori class ke choices tay karegi: language, tone, depth, kitne examples aur recaps, kaunsa hook aur engagement content kab aayega. Examples bhi uski pehchaani hui duniya se honge. Style Wrapper aur personalisation saath kaam karenge.

Mere bachche ko access kab milega?

Launch is planned for December 2026–January 2027. The introductory month starts when your child's access is activated. Paying ₹100 now reserves founding-family access; learning access starts after launch.

Founding Family ka exclusive benefit kya hai?

₹100 off each of the first six paid months, saving ₹600 in total. The introductory month is the standard introductory month, not an extra month exclusive to founding families.

₹100 ke baad kitna pay karna hoga?

If you choose to continue after the introductory month, your first paid bill is ₹1,299 after applying the ₹100 reservation credit. The next five paid bills are ₹1,399 each. After six paid months, the planned price is ₹1,499/month. There is no automatic subscription debit.

Kya PRIA Dock ₹100 mein included hai?

The ₹100 payment reserves founding-family access. The published offer does not specify hardware inclusion. Dock availability, supported setup and any separate price will be confirmed before purchase. Step checking needs clearly visible handwriting and a supported setup.

Camera aur child data ke baare mein kahan padhein?

RTAE can use camera, microphone and learning activity. Device permissions and the applicable parental consent are separate from pre-booking. Read the privacy policy for data processing, the demo's server processing, retention and privacy requests.

Cancel kar sakte hain? Launch delay hua toh?

You can cancel before the launch deadline for a full ₹100 refund. If Into3 has not launched by 31 January 2027, the reservation is fully refundable. Eligible refunds are manually initiated within 24 hours; bank or payment-provider settlement may take longer. Read the reservation-specific terms.

Founding-family offer kab close hoga?

This offer window closes on 2 November 2026 at 10:31 pm IST. The deadline is the same for everyone and does not reset on a return visit. Reservations made during the offer window keep their agreed founding-family terms.
